name: uspc-usdc
notes: NOT LIVE: do not deposit into, borrow from or loop against this pool until its contracts appear in mainnet.jsonl and the launch is announced.

oracle: its own runtime. USDC from Chainlink's USDC/USD feed, Templar's Pyth Lazer source (feed 7) and the RedStone wrapper. USPC from Chainlink's USPC NAV feed alone (Coinshift USPC net asset value in USD; no other source carries USPC).

USPC NAV publishes one round every 86400-86415 s (rounds 13-38, measured on mainnet 2026-11-27), and both max_age_secs (86400, the largest the gate allows) and the pool's own price check refuse a price older than 86400 s. USPC therefore has no valid price from 24 h after each round until the keeper refreshes after the next round lands: seconds plus the keeper interval, once a day. In that window borrows, collateral withdrawals and liquidations that need the USPC price stop.
USPC is priced at NAV, not at a market price: the pool values USPC collateral at the issuer's reported net asset value even if USPC trades below it.

pool.admin is GBC7HYZNLGNOICHXWENZFS4GFMWJ3Y5AK4WSBEJPW7J3PH4QWHYDV3NB (to confirm). The config names no oracle.admin, so the same account also takes this pool's oracle: runtime governance Admin and ownership of the Chainlink adapter. The deploy run holds every role under the CI deployer key until setup completes, then hands over: pool admin (also the Comet controller) via propose_admin/accept_admin; runtime governance Admin via SetRole; the Chainlink adapter via transfer_ownership/accept_ownership. The account must exist on mainnet before the config gate passes, and signs both accept_* calls after the run.

The Chainlink adapter's owner can upgrade it, change or remove its feeds, point it at another upstream proxy and recover tokens sent to it, directly and with no waiting time; ownership cannot be renounced.
pool: arguments to PoolFactory.deploy (salt is chosen at deploy time). oracle is a pool_oracle_adapter over a Templar proxy runtime.
min_collateral is effective (c_factor-weighted) collateral in 7-decimal oracle base units: 10000000000 = 1,000 USD.

usdc IRM at ir_mod = 1: 0.01% at U=0 (r_base 1000 is the contract minimum), 5.00% at 90%, 12.50% at 95%, 20.00% at 100% (r_three is not scaled by ir_mod). reactivity 50 moves ir_mod (bounded 0.1x-10x) by 0.432 x (U - 90%) per day.
Borrows stop at max_util 95%; withdrawals may push U to just under 100%, which is where r_three applies.

uspc is the Stellar asset USPC issued by GARSY67GO23LDNMWLB5CWW7E6AGHGPU5TCDZF4EYO5UMBV4V4R5FRBO2 (its Stellar Asset Contract), 7 decimals. Collateral only; r_base 1000 is the contract minimum. min_position = 10 USPC. Liquidation incentive tops out at (1 - c_factor) / 2 = 5%.
Immutable after setup: update_pool is disabled and reserves only accept disabling, so caps, IRM, factors, max_positions and min_collateral are permanent.
set_status 0 checks the backstop threshold; it is met by this pool's own activation stack (own factory, Comet, emissions-disabled backstop and synthetic no-value BLND/USDC legs), not real capital.
